description: Read one NF pipeline's full Markdown by P-number or repository-relative path. Use it after pipeline_list identifies a pipeline; do not use it to list pipelines (use pipeline_list instead) or read modules/assets (module_read / asset_read). pipeline is either a Pxx stem (P01, matched against the filename prefix) or a .md path under 03_管线库/ or a community pipelines/ directory; paths outside those roots and .. escapes are rejected. A missing pipeline is an error, not an empty result; reads one local file and returns its full text without truncation. Local-only; no auth or rate limits.

pipeline.description: Pxx stem (P01) or repository-relative .md path under 03_管线库/ or community/*/pipelines/.

name: pipeline_read

outputSchema.description: A pipeline file with its path and full Markdown body.

found.description: True when the pipeline was located.

text.description: Full pipeline Markdown as stored on disk.
